unit_cn: Unit 4 Adversity and Courage 逆境与勇气
source: 人教版2019选择性必修三 Unit 4 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、逆境/探险/航海/登山/坚持主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Great courage is often shown in times of adversity.
words.example_cn: 巨大的勇气往往在逆境之中显现。

words.example_en: Shackleton led a famous expedition to the Antarctic.
words.example_cn: 沙克尔顿率领了一支著名的南极探险队。

words.example_en: Their voyage across the icy sea was dangerous and difficult.
words.example_cn: 他们穿越冰海的航行既危险又艰难。

words.meaning_cn: 全体船员;全体工作人员;一群人
words.example_en: The whole crew had to camp on the ice after the ship sank.
words.example_cn: 船沉没后,全体船员只得在冰面上扎营。

words.example_en: The captain gave the order to abandon ship before it was crushed.
words.example_cn: 船被压碎前,船长下令弃船。

words.meaning_cn: 在(船、飞机、车)上;上(船、飞机、车)
words.example_en: With a friend's help, the boy managed to get aboard the ship.
words.example_cn: 在朋友的帮助下,这个男孩设法登上了船。

words.example_en: The crew watched their ship slowly sink into the freezing sea.
words.example_cn: 船员们眼看着自己的船慢慢沉入冰冷的海里。

words.example_en: The ship was crushed by the thick ice and could no longer sail.
words.example_cn: 船被厚厚的冰压碎,再也无法航行了。

words.example_en: They sailed for days on rough seas before reaching the island.
words.example_cn: 他们在汹涌的海上航行了好几天才到达那座岛。

words.example_en: A skilled navigator was needed to guide the small boat safely.
words.example_cn: 需要一位熟练的领航员引导小船安全前行。

words.example_en: No navy in the world ever stopped at that lonely island.
words.example_cn: 世界上没有哪支海军曾在那座孤岛停靠。

words.meaning_cn: 毅力;韧性;不屈不挠的精神
words.example_en: Only through perseverance did the men survive four months on the ice.
words.example_cn: 正是凭着毅力,这些人才在冰上存活了四个月。

words.example_en: They chose to persevere even when all hope seemed lost.
words.example_cn: 即使似乎已毫无希望,他们仍选择坚持下去。

words.example_en: Surviving the cold called for both courage and endurance.
words.example_cn: 熬过严寒既需要勇气,也需要忍耐力。

words.meaning_cn: 决心;下定决心;解决(问题);坚定的信念
words.example_en: Their firm resolve to get home filled the men with hope.
words.example_cn: 他们回家的坚定决心让大家充满希望。

words.example_en: He made a resolution to finish what he had started.
words.example_cn: 他下定决心要完成自己开始的事。

words.example_en: The leader's commitment to his men saved them from death.
words.example_cn: 这位领队对部下的奉献把他们从死亡中拯救出来。

words.example_en: Frank Wild stayed loyal to Shackleton through every hardship.
words.example_cn: 弗兰克·怀尔德在每一次艰难中都对沙克尔顿忠心耿耿。

words.meaning_cn: 真正的;真诚的;可信赖的
words.example_en: Their genuine concern for others kept the whole group together.
words.example_cn: 他们对他人真诚的关心让整个团队团结在一起。

words.example_en: In such danger, no one could afford to be selfish.
words.example_cn: 在这样的危险中,没有人能够自私自利。

words.meaning_cn: 痛苦的;悲惨的;令人难受的
words.example_en: They were crowded together in that cold and miserable place.
words.example_cn: 他们挤在那个又冷又凄惨的地方。

words.example_en: The cruel weather of the Antarctic tested their courage every day.
words.example_cn: 南极残酷的天气每天都在考验着他们的勇气。

words.example_en: Their damp clothes made the freezing nights even harder to bear.
words.example_cn: 潮湿的衣服让冰冷的夜晚更加难熬。

words.meaning_cn: 相当不错的;正派的;得体的
words.example_en: He dreamed of decent food and a warm, dry bedroom.
words.example_cn: 他梦想着像样的食物和一间温暖干燥的卧室。

words.example_en: He tried to picture a cosy bedroom far from the icy shore.
words.example_cn: 他努力想象一间远离冰岸的温馨卧室。

words.meaning_cn: (人生的)一段经历;(故事的)片段;插曲
words.example_en: This was an episode in his life that he would never forget.
words.example_cn: 这是他一生中永远难忘的一段经历。

words.example_en: For many, the motive for joining was to experience a great adventure.
words.example_cn: 对许多人来说,参加的动机是去体验一场伟大的冒险。

words.example_en: Back home, friends would envy him for his amazing adventure.
words.example_cn: 回到家后,朋友们会羡慕他经历了这场奇妙的冒险。

words.meaning_cn: 合格的;有资格的;胜任的
words.example_en: At first he was not qualified enough to join the expedition.
words.example_cn: 起初他还不够资格加入这次探险。

words.example_en: The captain assigned the boy the job of cooking for the crew.
words.example_cn: 船长把为船员做饭的工作分派给了这个男孩。

words.example_en: The officer carried out a thorough search of the wrecked ship.
words.example_cn: 那名军官对失事的船进行了彻底的搜查。

words.example_en: Despite the cold, the men worked with surprising vigour.
words.example_cn: 尽管天寒,这些人仍以惊人的活力工作着。

words.example_en: He was so enthusiastic about adventure that he hid aboard the ship.
words.example_cn: 他对冒险如此热衷,以至于偷偷藏在了船上。

words.example_en: Fortunately, every member of the crew was finally rescued.
words.example_cn: 幸运的是,全体船员最终都获救了。

words.example_en: Unfortunately, his first application to join was turned down.
words.example_cn: 遗憾的是,他第一次加入的申请被拒绝了。

words.example_en: Under their leader's guidance, the men never lost hope.
words.example_cn: 在领队的指引下,这些人从未失去希望。

words.example_en: On the island, music was their only form of recreation.
words.example_cn: 在岛上,音乐是他们唯一的消遣方式。

words.example_en: The sled dogs would bark loudly whenever danger came near.
words.example_cn: 每当危险临近,雪橇犬就会大声吠叫。

words.example_en: Explorers were paid low wages for such dangerous voyages.
words.example_cn: 探险者们做这种危险的航行只能拿到很低的工钱。

words.example_en: The company launched a campaign to promote its corporate image.
words.example_cn: 公司发起了一项活动来提升其企业形象。

words.example_en: The leader had advertised for brave men to join the expedition.
words.example_cn: 领队曾登广告招募勇敢的人加入探险。

words.example_en: An advertising campaign helped attract more volunteers.
words.example_cn: 一场广告宣传帮助吸引了更多志愿者。

words.example_en: One crew member was a motor expert who could fix the engine.
words.example_cn: 有一名船员是能修引擎的马达专家。

words.example_en: My young nephew loves reading stories of brave explorers.
words.example_cn: 我年幼的外甥喜欢读勇敢探险者的故事。

words.example_en: It took great effort to move all the heavy furniture inside.
words.example_cn: 把所有沉重的家具搬进来费了很大力气。

words.example_en: The young boy hid in a cupboard until the ship had set off.
words.example_cn: 船出发后,小男孩一直藏在橱柜里。

words.example_en: They gathered by the small stove to keep themselves warm.
words.example_cn: 他们围在小炉子旁取暖。

words.example_en: He had been playing rugby since the age of eight.
words.example_cn: 他从八岁起就一直在打橄榄球。
